process_notes: The gate was amended after the first k = 3 gate run (DEC-25 addendum). That run required every predicted probability within 1e-5 of v4's where penalties agree and failed at 9.7e-5, with all 98 penalties identical and every condition's mean log-likelihood within 1e-6 bits/coda of v4's. At that point no k = 9 log-likelihood, calibration or contrast number had been seen; the k = 9 run's log line showed only its run time and that no DEC-16 stop rule fired. All nine k and the calibration were then refitted in one batch from a clean tree.
During development the smoke test (a fixed L2 of 0.01, not this grid) printed sweep numbers; no setting of the sweep changed after them.
